points.name: 葵青货柜码头／HIT
points.detail: S07：nGen管理系统、远程龙门吊及自动驾驶车辆等智慧化技术；不将全港标为全自动，不表示对外开放。
points.detailEn: S07: nGen management, remotely operated gantry cranes and autonomous trucks. Not a claim of port-wide full automation or public access.

points.name: 大铲湾码头
points.detail: S18现代货箱码头集团2026-05-29称内部拖车100%电动化；点位移至底图可辨人工平台，非游客登岸许可。
points.detailEn: S18: 100% internal-tractor electrification reported 29 May 2026; marker moved onto the visible reclaimed platform, not visitor landing permission.

points.name: 万顷沙产业岸线（待核）
points.detail: 用户提出的现状产业候选片区；具体企业、岸线范围和船上可见性尚未独立核实，不与龙穴岛南沙港混同。
points.detailEn: User-nominated candidate industrial area. Operators, extent and boat visibility not independently verified; distinct from Nansha Port on Longxue Island.

points.name: 东涌炮台
points.detail: S19古迹办：1832年海防设施，1979年列古迹；渡轮接岸上交通为组合建议，不是已售套票。
points.detailEn: S19: 1832 coastal-defence site, declared in 1979. Ferry plus land transfer is a suggested itinerary, not an existing package.

points.name: 东涌小炮台
points.detail: S20古迹办：1817年海防遗存；与东涌炮台为两个对象，步行衔接须另核。
points.detailEn: S20: coastal-defence remains associated with 1817. Separate from Tung Chung Fort; pedestrian access requires checking.

points.name: 分流炮台
points.detail: S21古迹办：大屿山西南端、1729年海防遗存；未核定期客轮直达，不预设新停靠点。
points.detailEn: S21: 1729 fort at southwest Lantau. No scheduled direct ferry verified; no new landing assumed.

points.name: 下白泥碉堡
points.nameEn: Fortified Structure at Ha Pak Nai
points.detail: S22古迹办：约1910年革命史建筑；下白泥55号，官网有开放时段；没有核实水路客运到达。
points.detailEn: S22: revolutionary-history building dating to about 1910 at 55 Ha Pak Nai. Published opening hours; no passenger-ferry access verified.

points.name: 香港海事博物馆
points.detail: S08；中环八号码头，官网列开放时间。可与维港渡轮组合，非西岸沿线直接停靠点。
points.detailEn: S08: at Central Pier 8, with published opening hours. Candidate ferry-and-museum itinerary, outside the western-coast focus.

points.name: 林则徐销烟池与虎门销烟旧址
points.detail: F59第79、81页的既有海防历史资源；按真实底图虎门林则徐纪念馆／销烟旧址位置校正，与规划销烟池—大人山板块分开。参观入口、开放及水上衔接另核。
points.detailEn: F59 pp79/81: existing historic resource. Corrected to the real Humen Lin Zexu Memorial / opium-destruction-site position, distinct from the planned Daren Hill grouping; access and ferry links require checks.

points.name: 大虎山炮台遗址
points.detail: S30：全国重点文物保护单位组成部分；按底图大虎岛岛体校正，简易码头不是现营客运许可。与自然资源点重叠，不重复计景点。
points.detailEn: S30: part of a national protected monument; corrected to the Dahu Island landform in the basemap. A simple pier is not an operating passenger permit. Overlaps the nature record.

points.name: 上横挡岛／炮台
points.detail: S30：无居民海岛，炮台属林则徐销烟池及虎门炮台旧址全国重点文物保护单位的组成部分；现有旅游码头，规划游憩用岛，不证明班线或公众开放。检索别称：上横档岛。
points.detailEn: S30: uninhabited island; battery forms part of the national protected Humen heritage designation. Existing tourism pier and recreation-island plan do not establish ferry operation or public access.

points.name: 下横挡岛／炮台
points.detail: S30：无居民海岛，炮台属同一全国重点文物保护单位体系；全岛严格保护，旅游设施暂停营业。规划鼓励原有建筑改善接待科普，非现营岛游。检索别称：下横档岛。
points.detailEn: S30: uninhabited island; battery belongs to the same national monument system. Whole island strictly protected and tourism facilities suspended; planned reuse for visitors and education, not an operating tour.

points.name: 龙穴岛／三圣宫
points.detail: S30：有居民海岛，三圣宫为区登记保护文物、清晚期建筑；文化资源与生产港区分别记录，具体建筑定位、入口与开放待核。
points.detailEn: S30: inhabited island; district-registered late-Qing temple. Cultural resource recorded separately from the working port; exact building position, entrance and opening unverified.

points.name: 小虎岛能源与船舶产业
points.detail: S30：LNG、石化、船舶等现状产业，远观候选；按底图小虎岛岛体校正，安全与危化约束优先，不纳入公众登岸点。
points.detailEn: S30: existing LNG, petrochemical and shipbuilding uses; corrected to the Xiaohu Island landform in the basemap. Distant-view candidate subject to safety constraints, not a public landing.

points.name: 莲花山旅游区／望海观音
points.detail: S31广州文旅局：狮子洋畔，望海观音与莲花塔、莲花城构成文化地标；按真实底图莲花山旅游区坐标校正，非登船点。
points.detailEn: S31 Guangzhou tourism authority: Shiziyang waterfront landmark with Wanghai Guanyin, Lianhua Pagoda and Fort. Corrected to the real Lianhua Mountain scenic-area position; not a boarding point.

points.name: 小虎岛礼堂旧址／荣院／华院
points.detail: S30表2-4、表4-1：有居民小虎岛的人民公社礼堂旧址为历史建筑；荣院（西屋、东屋、凉亭）、华院（西院、东院）为传统风貌建筑。按底图小虎岛岛体校正，与产业点共用岛级定位，不是三座建筑坐标；公众开放、船上可见性及登岸衔接未核。
points.detailEn: S30 tables 2-4 and 4-1: Xiaohu's former commune assembly hall is historic, with Rongyuan and Huayuan traditional-character buildings. Corrected to the Xiaohu Island landform and intentionally shares the island marker with the industry point; not individual building coordinates.

areas.name: 龙穴岛南沙港作业片区
areas.detail: S30支持龙穴岛港航产业；沿底图人工岛岸概化，内部仅示研究作业片区，非经营权、危险区或公众通行边界。
areas.detailEn: S30 supports the port-island function. Generalised visible artificial shoreline and study footprint, not ownership, hazard or public-access limits.

areas.name: 大铲湾码头作业片区
areas.detail: S18确认运营；沿底图突出海岸的平台轮廓校核，非港区法定红线，泊位与观景距离另核。
areas.detailEn: S18 confirms operation; retraced visible reclaimed platform, not the legal port boundary. Berths and viewing distance require checks.

areas.name: 赤湾—蛇口港口临海作业带

areas.detailEn: S02 viewing subjects and F47 waterfront tasks; multi-operator landscape corridor, not one shared Chiwan/SCT legal boundary.

areas.name: 葵青货柜码头景观片区
areas.detail: S07支持港区技术与运营；青衣及葵涌岸线的概化研究片区，不是HIT全部泊位范围，海陆细部待港图核验。
areas.detailEn: S07 supports operation and technology. Generalised Tsing Yi / Kwai Chung study footprint, not all HIT berths; verify detailed land/water geometry against port charts.

lines.detail: S30港区外缘的候选远观界面，不是航线、安全距离或连续可见性结论。
lines.detailEn: S30: candidate outer-port viewing interface, not a sailing route, safe distance or verified continuous view.

lines.detailEn: S18: visible platform sea edge, pending boat-photo verification; not navigable geometry.

lines.detailEn: S02/F47: cranes and port-city views; avoid working waters, not a landing itinerary.

points.name: 沙洲及龙鼓洲海岸公园
points.nameEn: Sha Chau and Lung Kwu Chau Marine Park
points.detail: S09渔护署：1996年指定，约1200公顷；中华白海豚生境。示意面不是法定边界，不代表可自由靠岸。
points.detailEn: S09: designated in 1996, about 1,200 ha; Chinese white dolphin habitat. Indicative area is not its statutory boundary or permission to land.

points.name: 南大屿海岸公园相关水域
points.detail: S06：2022年指定海岸公园，2067公顷。仅示意石鼓洲及索罟群岛邻近海域，未取得法定边界数据。
points.detailEn: S06: marine park designated in 2022, 2,067 ha. General waters near Shek Kwu Chau and the Soko Islands only; statutory geometry not obtained.

points.name: 大澳水乡与大屿山西岸
points.detail: S10屯门—东涌—沙螺湾—大澳运营航线支持到达；山海／水乡复合景观，不保证观豚或未列明支线游船。
points.detailEn: S10: served by the Tuen Mun–Tung Chung–Sha Lo Wan–Tai O ferry. Coastal and village landscape; dolphin sightings and local excursion boats are not guaranteed.

points.name: 大虎岛／大虎山地质自然公园（规划）
points.nameEn: Dahu Island / planned geological nature park
points.detail: S30正式规划：99.06公顷；按底图大虎岛岛体校正，全岛生态红线及严格保护区，保护丹霞、海蚀地貌和炮台。可研究合规低干扰参观科普，非普通开发岛，未核公众登岛。
points.detailEn: S30 adopted plan: 99.06 ha; corrected to the Dahu Island landform in the basemap. The island is wholly within the ecological red line / strict protection zone; low-impact education may be studied, not ordinary development or verified access.

points.name: 九洲港片区石花山景观线索
points.detail: S29：2014控规报道明确石花山及炮台山山海景观；现状山体与历史规划分开，步道、观景开放及港口接驳待核。
points.detailEn: S29: 2014 planning report identifies Shihua and Paotai hills. Existing landform and historical proposals separated; paths, viewpoint access and port transfers unverified.

points.name: 九洲港片区炮台山景观线索
points.detail: S29历史规划报道所列山体；片区定位，不将山顶视点直接当作船上景观可见性。
points.detailEn: S29 hill named in historical planning coverage; area marker, not a verified boat viewshed.

points.name: 东澳岛
points.detail: S28海岛客运报道：自然山海及海防历史；中山挂港上午抵达后返程间隔短，深度游优先研究过夜。
points.detailEn: S28 island-service report: nature and defence history; short interval before the listed morning return favours an overnight concept from Zhongshan.

points.name: 黄山鲁森林公园
points.detail: F10第6、12页：南沙湾既有山体与山海廊道基底；按用户更正补录，与龙穴岛南沙生产港区分开。片区定位，公园界、入口和船上可见性待核。
points.detailEn: F10 pp6/12: existing hill landscape and planned mountain-coast corridors in Nansha Bay. Added after user clarification; separate from Longxue working port. Area marker; park boundaries, entrances and boat visibility unverified.

areas.name: 海鸥岛底图内景观范围示意
areas.detail: F44/S30；按参考海岛图与底图可见的海鸥岛局部岸形修正，北端与完整岛体超出底图，不是全岛面积或红树林工程边界。
areas.detailEn: F44/S30: corrected to the visible Haiou Island shoreline segment in the basemap and reference island map. The northern/full island extends beyond the basemap; not whole-island area or mangrove works boundary.

areas.name: 大角山滨海景观范围示意
areas.detail: F36；对应南沙湾岸侧生态海堤项目片区，手绘范围不是工程红线或修复面积。
areas.detailEn: F36: corrected to the Nansha Bay shore; hand-drawn outline is not the seawall works boundary or restoration area.

areas.name: 淇澳岛景观范围示意
areas.detail: 按用户底图可辨认岛岸重描，取代少顶点包络；岸线年代及地理配准仍待核，不是保护区界线。
areas.detailEn: Retraced against the visible island coast in the supplied basemap, replacing the coarse envelope; shoreline date and georeferencing remain unverified, not a protected-area boundary.

areas.name: 深圳湾北岸潮间带示意
areas.detail: F47；沿北岸湾形调整的研究带，潮位线、滩涂外缘及保护边界未测。
areas.detailEn: F47: study corridor adjusted to the north-shore bay form; tide line, mudflat edge and protection limits unmeasured.

areas.name: 内伶仃岛景观范围示意
areas.detail: 沿底图岛岸转折重描，不外扩为规则多边形；不表示游客可登岛。
areas.detailEn: Retraced along visible shoreline turns rather than a regular envelope; not permission for visitor landings.

areas.name: 桂山岛景观范围示意
areas.detail: 按底图岛岸转折重描，码头、填海年代和权属界线另核。
areas.detailEn: Retraced visible island shoreline turns; berths, reclamation date and ownership boundaries require separate checks.

areas.name: 沙洲及龙鼓洲海域研究范围

areas.detailEn: S09 supports the marine-park facts only. This hand-drawn study footprint is not the statutory 1,200 ha boundary.

sheets.finding: 东岸都市湾景与西岸城市海岸可形成差异化叙事；看见城市与进入城市是两种服务。
notes: 紫色虚线：待验证的城市景观岸段。

天气、船位、朝向、距离及遮挡尚未实测。

points.name: 华发冰雪世界／前海冰雪世界
points.detail: S33官方报道2025-09-29启动试营业；S34确认位于宝安国际会展片区、邻近深圳国际会展中心，不是南侧前海湾公园。用户指出水上识别度高，列为展靓候选；点为片区示意，建筑轮廓、船位和遮挡待船拍核验。
points.detailEn: S33 reports trial opening on 29 Sep 2025; S34 places it in Bao'an's international exhibition district, not the southern Qianhai Bay park. User identifies a prominent boat-view landmark; showcase candidate with indicative location and unmeasured viewshed.

points.name: 深圳国际会展中心（宝安）
points.detail: S34冰雪世界邻近地标；明确为宝安深圳国际会展中心，不是福田会展中心。大体量展馆群为展靓远观候选；用户提供水上可见线索，岸线遮挡、建筑准确位置与安全观景船位待核。
points.detailEn: S34 identifies the venue beside Snow World: Shenzhen World in Bao'an, not Futian Convention Center. Large exhibition halls are a user-nominated distant-view showcase; exact placement, obstructions and safe vessel viewpoints unverified.

points.name: 深圳宝安国际机场景观
points.detail: F45机场门户基底；机场航站楼、跑道及航空动态与T3机场客运码头分开记录。按用户意见列为展靓候选，不承诺所有船位均见起降；净空、安保、航道安全及能见度优先，非可进入跑道的游线。
points.detailEn: F45 airport-gateway setting; terminal, runway and aviation landscape are distinct from the airport ferry pier. User-nominated showcase, not guaranteed take-off views; aviation, security, navigation and visibility constraints apply.

points.name: 前海石公园／桂湾滨水公共空间
points.detail: F47前海石公园岸线任务及S35山海连城前海湾段；既有公共岸线作为展靓对象，2026后续提升另列P6。陆上慢行网络不等于水上航线；具体入口、临水界面与船上视线仍待核。
points.detailEn: F47 waterfront tasks and S35 Mountain-Sea City Qianhai Bay segment. Existing public waterfront is a showcase; subsequent 2026 works remain P6. Land-based active travel is not a ferry route; entrances and boat views require checks.

points.name: 深圳湾公园滨水岸线
points.detail: S35：西部50公里滨海骑行道已报道贯通，串联深圳湾公园；作为山海连城公共空间展靓节点，与N6敏感潮间带分别评价。滨水公园开放或骑行贯通不授权游船进入保护水域，非整条200公里规划全部建成。
points.detailEn: S35 reports the western 50 km coastal cycle connection through Shenzhen Bay Park. Mountain-Sea City public-space showcase, assessed separately from N6 sensitive intertidal habitat. Cycling access is not vessel permission, nor completion of the entire 200 km planned corridor.

points.detailEn: S11 offers harbour cruises and West Kowloon–Central services. This is not a western Tuen Mun outer-harbour cruise.

lines.label: 九洲港—港珠澳大桥海上游

lines.detailEn: S26 and user clarification: depart Jiuzhou, make a sightseeing loop around both sides of the Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao Bridge and its east/west artificial islands, then return. About 90 minutes is historical; this is a conceptual loop, not an AIS track, navigation route or proof of a 2026 sale.
